summary: Proofs are mostly automation-based and free of `change`/`show` or defeq abuse, but the main theorem proves a conjunct it never uses, the new public relabelling equivs have no characterizing lemmas so every fact about them is buried in unfolding, and two proofs use an opaque `▸` cast.
